models.method: Compare admissible actions across plausible scenarios and downside constraints; use sensitivity analysis.
models.stop_when: Stop when an action remains acceptable across plausible states or a review deadline arrives.
models.failure_mode: Robustness can sacrifice high average benefits; scenario boundaries are assumptions.

models.method: Set minimal acceptable criteria and a bounded search cost; select a qualifying option.
models.stop_when: Stop at the first qualifying option or the precommitted budget.
models.failure_mode: Poor thresholds can exclude important value.

models.method: Assess probabilities, utility of outcomes, and feasibility; compare expected utility.
models.stop_when: Stop when the preferred choice survives sensitivity checks.
models.failure_mode: Probabilities and preferences may be unjustified; ruin is not offset by averages.

models.method: Identify information that can change action; compare expected value with collection and delay costs.
models.stop_when: Stop when marginal decision value does not justify cost or deadline passes.
models.failure_mode: Entropy reduction is not necessarily decision value; EVSI requires a test model.

models.method: Define states, transitions, rewards and horizon; compare policies via backward induction where justified.
models.stop_when: Stop when policy differences are robust to transition uncertainty or cost bounds bind.
models.failure_mode: Incorrect state or transition model invalidates Bellman results.

models.method: Map actors, stated interests, actual authority and available evidence without assuming strategic adaptation.
models.stop_when: Stop when actors and material constraints are mapped enough for a choice.
models.failure_mode: Mistaking unknown incentives for deliberate strategy.

models.method: Specify players, action sets, payoffs, information and best responses; test alternative games.
models.stop_when: Stop after identifying plausible responses and robust responses to them.
models.failure_mode: Assumed rationality and invented payoffs cause false precision.

models.method: Represent at least two evidenced perceived games; identify strategic disagreement and tests of perception.
models.stop_when: Stop when perception uncertainty has been bounded enough to select a safe strategy.
models.failure_mode: Unfalsifiable second-order mind-reading is not evidence.

models.method: Map stocks, flows, reinforcing and balancing loops, delays and observable interventions.
models.stop_when: Stop after a feedback hypothesis yields testable predictions and safe intervention choices.
models.failure_mode: A causal-loop drawing is not proof of causation.

models.method: Specify outcome, possible causes, confounders and rival mechanisms; seek discriminating tests.
models.stop_when: Stop when evidence supports an intervention or test plan.
models.failure_mode: Observational correlations do not establish causality.

models.method: Map observed cue, routine and reward; change one variable and measure recurrence.
models.stop_when: Stop/revise when repeated observed behavior shows no improvement.
models.failure_mode: Not every repeated failure is a habit.

models.method: Compare skill, environment, incentives, health, choice and cue explanations before choosing a mechanism.
models.stop_when: Stop when an observation or small experiment distinguishes plausible mechanisms.

models.method: Target the measured subskill, practice just beyond current performance, obtain feedback and retest.
models.stop_when: Stop or retarget when test performance stabilizes or transfers.
models.failure_mode: Repeated practice without useful feedback can entrench errors.

models.method: Use retrieval and transfer tests to locate knowledge, retrieval, reasoning or execution gaps.
models.stop_when: Stop when a specific skill deficit is reproducible.
models.failure_mode: A single poor score may reflect fatigue or measurement noise.

models.method: Reduce observed switching triggers; reserve uninterrupted work and compare outcome with baseline.
models.stop_when: Stop/revise after comparable work blocks show no gain.
models.failure_mode: Deep work is not superior for every task; urgent interruptions may be justified.

models.method: Log task starts, interruptions and outputs; identify whether attention is the bottleneck.
models.stop_when: Stop when a repeated mechanism is observed or alternate constraint dominates.
models.failure_mode: Subjective distraction reports can misclassify bottlenecks.

models.method: With random order, no recall and fixed horizon, sample about 1/e then select next record breaker.
models.stop_when: Stop upon first qualifying candidate or end of finite horizon.
models.failure_mode: The ~37% policy maximizes selecting best under strict assumptions, not welfare.

models.method: Model recall, arrival distribution, utility, urgency and search costs; derive a contextual threshold.
models.stop_when: Stop when next-search value falls below waiting cost or a deadline arrives.
models.failure_mode: A constant universal fraction is not justified.
